answers.material_claim: Equal resource IDs in different tenants must continue to produce distinct cache keys.

expected_claims.text: Equal resource IDs in different tenants must continue to produce distinct cache keys.

expected_findings.claim: The refactored key omits tenant_id, so equal resource IDs collide across tenants.
expected_findings.rationale: Base incorporates tenant_id and resource_id, while head returns only resource_id. Two tenants using the same resource ID now receive the same cache key, violating the user-confirmed isolation constraint and risking cross-tenant cache contamination. This is a required high regression, and the return-value change alone proves the full claim from the diff.
